ONE CONNECTED WORKFLOW

Everything a modern printing shop needs to operate and grow

Designed around real printing services—not a generic retail POS—so beginners can follow the workflow while experienced operators keep full control.

POS

Printing-first POS

Rush ID, documents, photos, stickers, tarpaulin, laminating, PVC ID, school supplies, GCash services, and custom products.

AI

Local photo tools

Background removal, face enhancement, Auto Visa, crop, masking, retouch, and CPU fallback without uploading customer portraits.

INV

Inventory by actual use

Deduct paper, film, rolls, cards, and materials by sheet fit, dimensions, pieces, or real consumed area.

₱

True pricing metrics

Combine materials, labor, electricity, rent, operating costs, service fees, and your target profit margin.

WEB

Online print jobs

Customers select a shop, upload files, add instructions, receive a job code, and track production status.

REP

Reports and insights

Daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly performance with sales, profit, inventory, and busiest-period insights.

UP

Secure updates

Detect a new version at startup, verify hashes, apply small patches when possible, and preserve business data.

ROLE

Owner, Partner, Admin, Cashier

Server-authorized Developer and Partner access plus clear shop roles and protected subscription controls.

START SMALL • OWN THE CORE • AUTOMATE WITH PREMIUM

Choose the level that matches your print shop

Lite is a low-cost Rush ID starter. Regular permanently unlocks everyday local shop operations. Premium removes AI, automation, online-job, analytics, template, and customization limits.

LITE — ₱39 ONE-TIME

Start with Rush ID

  • Rush ID package workflow
  • Single-customer processing
  • Checkout, receipt, and transaction history
  • Basic Rush ID stock tracking
  • No Subject Editor, Refine, AI, batch, or Company Profile
REGULAR — ₱99 LIFETIME

Run normal local shop work

  • Standard printing and finishing services
  • Company Profile, inventory, and basic reports
  • Manual pricing and service variations
  • Manual Subject Editor and Refine
  • No AI automation, online jobs, advanced analytics, or custom Template Builder
PREMIUM — UNLIMITED NORMAL SHOP USE

Automate production and growth

  • Face Enhance Model and Background Removal
  • Easy ID & Visa Builder with Rush ID Batch
  • Calling Card, Ticket, and Template Builders
  • Automatic Pricing and advanced reports
  • Online Print Jobs, POS customization, and priority tools

SUPPORTED WINDOWS PCS

Start on a normal shop computer and scale up when needed

The sale-ready installer is self-contained and uses the CPU AI runtime by default for maximum compatibility.

Minimum
  • Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
  • Intel/AMD 4-core CPU
  • 8 GB RAM
  • 10 GB free storage
  • CPU AI mode
  • 1366×768 display
RECOMMENDED FOR SHOPSRecommended
  • Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5 or better
  • 16 GB RAM
  • 20 GB free SSD storage
  • NVIDIA GPU with 4 GB VRAM optional
  • Full HD display
High-volume
  • Modern 8-core CPU
  • 32 GB RAM
  • Fast NVMe SSD
  • NVIDIA 6 GB+ VRAM
  • Reliable broadband for web sync
  • Regular database backups
SIMPLE ONBOARDING

From registration to the first completed sale

01

Create a shop account

Use your email and password to create a secure PrintMarks account. Choose Printing Shop so your profile connects to the Windows app.

02

Start the trial

Log in to the Windows app using the same account. Developer and authorized Partner roles bypass subscriptions.

03

Configure your shop

Add inventory, printers, services, prices, company details, and payment settings.

04

Process real orders

Use POS for walk-ins and receive online jobs from customers through the web portal.
